items.title: Geno Smith: Late INT seals sixth loss
items.text:
Smith completed 20 of 32 passes for 290 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He also rushed once for four yards.

items.title: Bijan Robinson: Manages solid rushing total in shutout
items.text:
Robinson rushed 19 times for 76 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Mike Washington: Career-high 25 carries in Week 8 win
items.text:
Washington rushed 25 times for 83 yards and wasn't targeted in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

items.title: Michael Wilson: Has broken ribs
items.text:
Wilson said after Sunday's 33-30 win at Dallas that he suffered two broken ribs during the contest, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Picturesque TD catch in loss
items.text:
Jefferson brought in five of nine targets for 33 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
